a: Shishsha lindava. chizkiyya amar. keneged shishsha vatte avot. bar pedaya amar. keneged shesh behemot. par veegel vesair eyil ugedi utele. shemuel amar. keneged shesh karbanot. kinne zavim kinne zavot kinne yoldot chattaot vaashshamot hammenachot vaasirit haefa. amar ribbi yochanan. al yede shehannedava merubba rivu lah shofarot harebe. [shenneemar] uchechallotam heviu lifne hammelech vihoyada vegomer. ribbi shemuel bar nachman beshem ribbi yonatan [amar]. shete nedavot [asa]. tanne ribbi yishmael. nedava achat. veha chetiv vayyomer hammelech vayyaasu aron echad vayyittenuhu beshaar bet Adonai chutza. amar rav chona. mippene hattemeim. ribbi chuna veshem rav yosef. al shem ach lo yease bet Adonai sippot kesef. min sippot kesef lo yease vet Adonai.

Mishna: maot shennimtzeu ben shekalim lindava karov lashshekalim yippalu lashshekalim lannedava yippelu lannedava mechetza lemechetza yippelu lannedava. ben etzim lilvona karov laetzim yippelu laetzim lallevona yippelu lallevona mechetza lemechetza yippelu lallevona. ben kinnim legozle ola karov lakkinnim yippelu lakkinnim legozle ola yippelu legozle ola. mechetza lemechetza yippelu legozle ola. ben chullin lemaaser sheni karov lachullin yippelu lachullin lemaaser sheni yippelu lemaaser sheni mechetza lemechetza yippelu lemaaser sheni. ze hakkelal holchin achar hakkarov mechetza lemechetza lehachemir:

Halacha: maot shennimtzeu ben shekalim lindava 56. la tzorcha dela ven shekalim likinnim. ribbi avun veshem ribbi finchas. kemin kochliyaym hayu asuyin. la tzorcha dela mechetza lemechetza yippelu lishkalim. it devae memar. shemma yippelu lesiyyere hallishka. it devae memar. mechetza lemechetza kemi shemmet. amar ribbi yasa. ad daana tamman shemait kal rav yehuda sheal lishmuel. hifrish shiklo vamet. amar leh. yippelu lindava. asirit haefa shello. ribbi yochanan amar. yolichem leyam hammelach. ribbi lazar amar. yippelu lindava.

Vekashya. veyesh chattat kereva ola. ribbi chizkiyya achi veshem ribbi shimon ben lakish. tenayy vet din hu al hammotarot sheyyikrevu olot. haishsha hazzot bamme hi mitkapperet. amar ribbi yitzchak. tenayy vet din hu. hamesappek et hakkinnim hu mesappek et happesulot. la tzorcha dela ven ketoret laetzim lilvona lezahav lakkapporet. vetannitah besofah. holchin achar hakkarov mechetza lemechetza lehachemir.

Mishna: maot shennimtzeu lifne sochare behema leolam maaser. uvehar habbayit chullin. uvirushalam vishar yemot hashshana chullin uvishat haregel hakkol maaser. basar shennimtza baazara evarim olot. vachatichot chattaot. uvirushalayim zivche shelamim. ze vaze teubbar tzurato veyetze levet hashsherefa. nimtza baggevulin evarim nevelot vachatichot muttarot. uvishat haregel shehabbasar merubbe af evarin muttarot:
Halacha: la tzorcha dela behar habbayat kodesh. ribbi ba ribbi chiyay veshem ribbi yochanan. chazzaka sheen hakkohen motzi min hallishka maot ad shehu mechallan al habbehema.

Ribbi lazar veshem ribbi hoshaya. hissia daat taon tzura. amar rav hoshaya. matnita amra chen. teubbar tzurato veyetze levet hashsherefa. amar ribbi yose veyeut. leochlo en at yachol shemma nitkalokla tzurato. lefum chen tzarach memar. teubbar tzurato veyetze levet hashsherefa.

Ribbi kerispa veshem ribbi yose beribbi chaneyina. evarim nevelot lokin alehen mishshem nevela. matnita amra chen. evarim nevelot vachatichot muttarot. chatichot muttarot lo mammash. vedichvavtah evarim nevelot lokin alehen mishshem nevela.

Ribbi kerispa veshem ribbi yose ben chanina. im hayu mecharozot muttarot. tasha chanuyot mochrot besar nevela veachat mocheret besar shechuta nitchallefu lo. choshesh. velannimtzet holchin achar harov. tasha chanuyot mochrot besar shechuta veachat mocheret besar nevela nitchallefu lo. choshesh. velannimtzet holchin achar harov.

Amar ribbi yochanan. hannimtza veyad goy kenimtza vappallatya. ribbi lazar beribbi chaggayy hava mesammech leribbi mana. chama lechad aramay mekattea min suseh umappik livra. amar leh. hada hi deamar ribbi yochanan. hannimtza veyad goy kenimtza vappallatya. amar leh. ken amar ribbi yose ribbi. vehen serau oto yotze mimmakkuylin shel yisrael. chad bar nash betzipporin azal bae mizvon kuppad min tabbecha vela yehav leh. amar leh lechad romayy veayyti leh. amar leh. la nasbit al karcheh. amar. velav besar dinvela yehavit leh. ribbi yirmeya veshem ribbi chanina. maase va lifne ribbi veamar. la chulla minneh messor makkuylin detzipporin.

Rav nechat letamman. chamton mekilon vachamar alehon. chad bar nash azal bae meshigga eskofteh begav nahara veinshitah vaazal leh. chazar bae misvine. amar leh rav. asiur lach. dana amar. hahi shetaf nahara veayyti churi dinvela tochtoy. chad bar nash hava mehallech beshuka tain kuppad. ata dayyta vachatafteh mineh utelakteh. chazar bae misvine. amar leh rav. asir lach. dana amar. basar dinvela havavt teina utelakteh venasvat hahu ochrana.
Ginay shetaf zikin. ata ovda kome ribbi yitzchak bar elazar veamar. yachkemon shefayay kitrehon.
Nukenika ishtakkach bichnishta devule. ata ovda kome ribbi yirmeya. amar. yachkemon sikiyayriyya avidtehon.

Gedi tzeli ishtakkach beisrata degufeta. vehittiruhu mishshem shene devarim. mishshem metzia umishshem rov mehalleche derachim. mishshem metzia. detanne. hammatztzil miyyad haari miyyad haggayis mishshunat hayyam umishshunat hannahar umeysratya gedola umippallatya gedola hare ellu shello. mippene shehabbealim mityayashin mehen. mishshem rov mehalleche derachim. mishem shechitat haggoy. veishshetakkach min devet ribbi.

Igul deguvena ishtakkach befunedaka delevi. vehittiruhu mishshem shene devarim. mishshem metzia umishshem rov mehalleche derachim. mishshem metzia. detanne. hammatztzil miyyad haggayis miyyad haari mishshunat hayyam mishshunat hannahar meisteratya gedola umippallatya gedola hare ellu shello. mippene shehabbealim mityayashin mehen. mishshum rov mehalleche derachim. mishshum gevinat goy. veishshetakkach min deribbi elazar beribbi yose.

Amar ribbi mana kome ribbi yose. vaanan chamyayn rabbanin machrizin. amar leh. [in at] havivyta mashkach la nasvat. ribbi yona avuch lo amar ken ella amar. hallevay kad nashkach nashkach min fiyyosros ulegev. afilu chen ashkach vela nesav.

Mishna: behema shennimtzet mirushalayim vead migdal eder uchemiddatah lechol ruach zecharim olot. nekevot zivche shelamim. ribbi yehuda omer harauy lifsachim lifsachim kodem laregel sheloshim yom: barishona hayu memashkenin et motzeha ad shehu mevi nesacheha. chazru lihyot mannichin otah uvorchin. hitkinu bet din sheyyehu nesacheha bain mishshel tzibbur: amar ribbi shimon shiva devarim hitkinu bet din veze echad mehen. goy sheshshillach olato mimmedinat hayyam veshillach immah nesacheha kerevin mishello veim lav kerevin moshshel tzibbur. vechen ger shemmet vehinniach zevachim im yesh lo nesachim kerevin mishshelo veim lav kerevin mishshel tzibbur. tenayy bet din hu al kohen gadol shemmet shettehe minchato kereva mishshel tzibbur. ribbi yehuda omer mishshel yorshin. ushelema hayta kereva: al hammelach veal haetzim sheyyehu hakkohanim neotin bahen veal happara shello yehu moalin beefrah. al hakkinnin happesulot sheyyehu vaot mishshel tzibbur ribbi yose omer hamesappek et hakkinnin hu mesappek et happesulot:

Halacha: ribbi hoshaya rabba amar. Rava bidmehen shanu. amar leh ribbi yochanan. omrim lo leadam. tze umeol vakkodashim. ella hillechu vahen achar harov. im rov zecharim. olot. im rov nekevot. zivche shelamim. veen hashshelamim bain min hazzecharim umin hannekevot. ketzad hu ose. motzian lachulin vechozer veose otan olot. amar ribbi zeura. kema deat amar tamman. tenayy vet din hu al hammotarot sheyyikkarvu olot. ken at amar of hacha. tenayy vet din hu al haovdot sheyyikkarvu olot. amar ribbi yose leribbi yaakov bar acha. en ze mezid. amar leh. mikkevan shehu tenayy vet din en ze mezid.

Amar ribbi yasa. ad daana tamman shemait kal rav yehuda sheal shemuel. hifrish shiklo [vamet]. amar leh. yippelu lindava. motar asirit haefa shello. ribbi yochanan amar. yolichem leyam hammelach. ribbi elazar amar. yippelu lindava.

Asirit haefa shelkohen gadol. [ribbi yochanan omer.] chotze otah veacharkach mekaddeshah. ribbi shimon ben lakish amar. mekaddeshah veachar kach chotze otah. matnito feliga al ribbi yochanan. makriv mechetza umechetza aved. patar lah. shekken afilu maot yelchu leyam hammelach. matnita feliga al ribbi shimon ben lakish. nimtzeu shene chatzayin kerevin ushene chatzayin avedin. vetanne alah. mechetza ze rishon mechetza sheni teubbar tzurato veyetze levet hasserefa. patar lah keribbi yishmael. deribbi yishmael amar. ishsharon mekaddesh. keshehakkohen mitkkarev techilla laavoda mevi ashirit shello veovdah veyado. echad kohen gadol veachad kohen hedyot sheavdu ad shello heviu asirit haefa shellahem avodatam keshera. ribbi mana vae memar. bo vayyom nitkarev kattechilla laavoda. bo vayyom nitmanne lihyot kohen gadol. mevi shetayim. achat lechinnucho veachat lechovat hayyom.

Tufine. bishat havaa tufine veen bashshacharit tufine. veha tanninan. heemidu ose chavittin laasot chavittin. amar ribbi chiyay bar ada. laasot chammin lerakkecham. tufine. ribbi yasa veshem ribbi chanina. metaggenah veachar kach ofe otah. ribbi acha veshem ribbi chanina. ofe otah veachar kach metaggenah. tufine. tuafina na. ribbi amar. tofnah rakka. ribbi dosa amar. tofnah noyy. atyayn ellen pelugvavta kehinnen pelugvavta. man deamar. tofnah noy. keman deamar. metaggenah veachar kach ofe. man deamar. tofnah rakka. keman deamar. ofe otah veachar kach metaggenah.

Lo sof davar shemmet ella afilu nitma. vaafilu nidche mimmum. tanna ribbi yuda bar pazi devar dalaya. vaafilu nidche mimmum. menayin lechohen gadol shemmet velo minu chohen acher tachtav tehe minchato kereva mishshelyorshin. talmud lomar mibbanav yaase. yachol yeviennah lachatztzayim. talmud lomar otah. kullah amarti divre ribbi yuda. ribbi shimon omer. enah vaa ella mishsheltzibbur. shenneemar chok olam. mimmi shehabbiryot shello. kalil taktar. kalil lehaketara.

Ribbi ba bar mamal bae . michlefa shittateh deribbi shimon. tamman hu amar. mishshelyorshin. vehacha hu amar mishsheltzibbur. amar ribbi chiyay bar ba. velo yeut hu makshe. ata ribbi yaakov bar acha ribbi abbahu veshem ribbi yochanan. devar tora hu shettehe vaa min hatztzibbur. hayiti omer. yigbu lah. hitkinu shettehe vaa mitterumat hallishka.

Ribbi yose amar. ribbi yochanan bae. ma. shelema veshacharit ushelema ven haarbayim. o mechetza veshacharit umechetza ven haarbayim. [o shelema shacharit uvetela ven haarbayim.] kad tehe feshita leh. sheloshet lugin ma hen. sheloshet lugin beshacharit usheloshet lugin ben haarbayim. o log umechetza veshacharit velog umechetza ven haarbayim. amar ribbi chizkiyya. of hada tzericha leh shene kematzin ma hen. shene kematzin beshacharit ushene kematzin ben haarvayim. o kometz echad beshacharit vekometz echad ben haarbayim. amar ribbi yose. kelum lamdu lakometz lo mimminchat chote. ma lehallan shene kematzin af kan shene kematzin. ma tamman tzericha leh. af hacha tzericha leh. amar ribbi chizkiyya. kelum lamdu sheloshet lugin lo mittamid shelben haarbayim. ma lehallan sheloshet lugin. af kan sheloshet lugin. [uma] tamman tzericha leh. (vehacha feshita) [af kan tzericha] leh.

Ribbi shemuel bar nachman beshem ribbi yonatan. bedin haya sheyyimalu vah. vehen gazru shello yimalu vah. veha tanne chattat. melammed shemmoalin bah. [bah moalin] veen moalin baafarah. amar ribbi abbahu. barishona hayu mishtakshekin bah venotnin otah gabbe makkotehen vegazru sheyyimalu vah. kevan shennigderu gazru shello yimalu vah.
Haishsha hazzot bamme hi mitkapperet. amar ribbi yitzchak. tenayy vet din hu hamesappek et hakkinnim hu mesappek et happesulot veet haovdot.

Mishna: kol harukkin hannimtzain birushalayim tehorin chutz mishshel shuk haelyon divre ribbi meir. ribbi yose omer bishar kol yemot hashshana shebbaemtza temein shebbatztzedadin tehorin. uvishat haregel shebbaemtza tehorin shebbatztzedadin temein shemmippene shehammuatin mistallekin latztzedadin: kala hakkelim hannimtzain birushalayim derech yerida levet hattevila temein vederech aliyya tehorin shello kiridatan aliyaytan divre ribbi meir. ribbi yose omer kullan tehorin chutz min hassal vehammagrefa hameyuchadin lakkevarot: sakkin shennimtzet bearbaa asar shochet bah miyyad. bishlosha asar shone umatbil. kofitz ben baze uven baze shone umatbil. chal arbaa asar lihyot beshabbat shochet bah miyyad. bachamishsha asar shochet bah miyyad. nimtzet keshura lesakkin hare zo kassakkin:

Halacha: kol harukkin 56. ribbi abbin beshem ribbi yehoshua ben levi. katzran shelgoyim haya sham. amar ribbi chanina. arudot hayu nocharin birushalam vehayu ole regalim mishtakkein baddam ad arkuvotehen. [uvau lifne chachamim velo amru lahem davar.] ribbi shimon bar abba veshem ribbi chanina. katzran shelgoyim haya sham.

Ribbi simon beshem ribbi yehoshua ben levi. maase vefirda mishshelbet ribbi shemmeta vetiharu et dameha mishem nevela. ribbi elazar sheil leribbi simon. ad kamma. velo aggiveh. sheil leribbi yehoshua ben levi. amar leh. ad reviit tahor. yoter mikken tame uveash leribbi lazar dela chazar leh ribbi shimon shemuata. rav bevay hava yetiv matne haden ovda. amar leh ribbi yitzchak bar bisna. ad reviit tahor. yoter mikken tame. uveit beh. amar leh ribbi zerikan. begin dehu sheal lach at bait beh. amar leh. [begin] dela havavt dati bi. deamar ribbi chanin. vehayu chayyecha teluyim lecha minneged. ze shehu lokeach lo chittim lashshana. ufachadta layla veyomam. ze shehu lokeach min hassidaki. velo taamin bechayye‍ycha. ze shehu lokeach min happaltar. vaana semich lefaltera. may chedon. heid ribbi yehoshua ben petira al dam nevelot shehu tahor. mahu tahor. tahor millehachshir. ha letammot metamme. tamman tanninan. dam hashsheretz metamme kivsaro. metamme veeno machshir. veen lanu kayyotze vo. en lanu kayyotze vo shiur tumeato. aval damo metamme kivsaro. amar rav yosef. man deamar tame. keribbi yehuda. uman deamar tahor. keribbi yehoshua ben batira. amar leh rav avudama nechuta. veyaut. ribbi yuda modiyayneh denasiyay hava.

Lo chen amar ribbi abbahu veshem ribbi yose ben chanina. lo gazru al harukkim shebbirushalam. [ha itmar] aleh. ribbi abbin beshem ribbi yehoshua ben levi. katzran shelgoyim haya sham. bishar yemot hashshana hattemeim mehallechin shibbolet vehattehorin mehallechin min hatztzad. vehattehorin mehallechin setam vehattemeim omrim lahem. perushu. bishat haregel hattehurin mehallechin shibbolet vehattemein mehallechin min hatztzad. vehattemeim mehallechin setam vehattehorin omrin lahen. perushu.
Lo chen amar ribbi abbahu veshem ribbi yochanan. lo gazru al hakkelim shebbirushalam. mikkevan shennimtzeu derech yerida levet tevila naasu hochiach.
Abba shaul haya kore otan tzipporen. man deamar tzipporen. shehu dome latztzipporen. man deamar meritza. shehi meritza et haeven [levet hakkevarot.]
Tanne. hassakkin keshura lo hare zo chemotah.

Mishna: parochet shennitmet bivlad hattumea matbilin otah bifnim umachnisin otah miyyad. veet shennitmet beav hattumea matbilin otah bachutz veshotchin otah bachel mippene shehi tzericha haarev shemesh. im hayta chadasha shotchin otah al gag haitztava kede sheyyiru haam et melachtah shehi naa: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer mishshem rabbi shimon ben hassegan parochet ovyah tefach al shivim ushetayim nimim neereget al kol nima venima esrim vearbaa chutin. arkah arbaim amma verachbah esrim umishshemonim ushete ribbo hayta naaset. ushetayim osin bechol shana ushelosh meot kohanim matbilin otah:

Halacha: illu amar chut. echad. kaful. lishnayim. shazur. lishlosha. mashzar. leshishsha. arba mikkan. ha esrim vearbaa. tanne. sheloshim ushenayim. illu amar chut. echad. kaful. lishnayim. shazur. learba. mashzar. lishmona. arbaa mikkan. ha taltin uterey. tanne. arbaim ushemona. illu amar chut. echad. kaful. lishnayim. kelia. lishlosha. shazur. leshishsha. mashzar. lishnem asar. arbaa mikkan. ha arbain utemanya.

Katuv echad omer. maase rokem. vechatuv acher omer. maase choshev. maase rokem. peratzof echad. maase choshev. shene peratzoppot. ribbi yuda veribbi nechemya. chad amar. maase rokem ari mikkan vaari mikkan. maase choshev. ari mikkan vechalak mikkan. vechorana amar. maase rokem. ari mikkan vechalak mikkan. maase choshev. ari mikkan venesher mikkan.
(Tanne.) bishshemonim ushetaym ribbo hayta naaset. ribbi yitzchak bar bisna veshem shemuel. gezuma. tamman tanninan. peamim alav kishlosh meot kor. ribbi yose beribbi bun beshem shemuel. gezuma.

Mishna: besar kadshe kadashim shennitma ben beav hattumea beyn bivlad hattumea ben bifnim ben bachutz bet shammay omrim hakkol yissaref bifnim chutz mishshennitma beav hattumea bachutz. bet hillel omrim hakkol yishsharef bachutz chutz mishshennitma bivlad hattumea bifnim: ribbi eliezer omer shennitma beav hattumea ben bifnim ben bachutz yishsharef bachutz. shennitma bivlad hattumea ben bifnim ben bachutz yissaref bifnim. ribbi akiva omer mekom tumeato sham serefato:

Halacha: bar kappara amar. av hattumea devar tora. vevlad hattumea middivrehen. ribbi yochanan amar. ben ze uven ze devar tora. vekashya deribbi yochanan al devet shammay. devet shammay omrin hakkol yissaref bifnim chutz mishshennitma beav hattumea vachutz. ma ven [av] hattumea vachutz ma ven vevlad hattumea vachutz. ze vaze lo devar tora hu. vaafilu al devet hillel lo makshiyay. devet hillel amrin hakkol yishsharef bachutz chutz mishshennitma bivvlad hattumea vifnim. ma ven vevlad hattumea vifnim ma ven av hattumea vifnim. ze vaze lo devar tora hu. la have vah rabbanin ella al devar kappara. vekashya devar kappara al devet shammay. devet shammay amrin. hakkol yissaref bifnim chutz minnitma beav hattumea vachutz. ma ven av hattumea ven bachutz ben bifnim. ze vaze lo devar tora hu. begin deribbi akiva amar. mekom tumeato sham tehe serefato. vaafilu al devet hillel let hi makshiyay. devet hillel amrin. hakkol yishsharef bachutz chutz mishshennitma bivlad hattumea vifnim. ma ven vevlad hattumea ben bifnim ben bachutz. ze vaze lo middivrehem hu. begin ribbi shimon. deribbi shimon amar. maachalo umashko shelmetzora mishtallechin chutz (vishlosh) [lishlosh] machanot.

Mishna: evare hattamid nittanin machatzi kevesh ulematta bammaarav shel musafin nittanin mechatzi kevesh ulematta bammizrach shel rashe chodashim nittanin al karkov hammizbeach millemaalan. hashshekalim vehabbikkurim enan nohagin ella bifne habbayit. aval masar dagan umasar behema uvechorot nohagin ben bifne habbayit uven shello bifne habbayit. hammakdish shekalim uvikkurim hare ze kodesh. ribbi shimon omer haomer bikkurim kodesh enan kodesh:
Halacha: e zehu karkov hammizbeach. amma ven keren lakkeren. mekom hilluch ragle hakkohanim.

Musefe shabbat musefe rosh chodesh mi kodem. ribbi yirmeya sevar memar. musefe shabbat umusefe rosh chodesh musefe rosh chodesh kodmin. cheyleh deribbi yirmeya min hada. shiro shelshabbat veshiro shelrosh chodesh shiro shelrosh chodesh kodem. amar ribbi yose. shanyay hi tamman deamar ribbi chiyay veshem ribbi yochanan. kede lefarsemo ulehodia shehu rosh chodesh. ketzad haya ose. shochet musefe shabbat veomrim alehen shiro shelrosh chodesh. beram hacha. musefe shabbat umusefe rosh chodesh musefe shabbat kodmin. al shem. kol hattadir mechavero kodem et chavero.

Ha shekalim kadshu. ribbi shimon ben yehuda amar mishshem ribbi shimon. ben ellu uven ellu lo kadshu. tanne. hagger bizman hazze tzarich lehavi kinno rivat kesef. amar ribbi shimon. bittelah rabban yochanan ben zakkay mippene hattekala. mahu mippene hattekala. kehada detanne. en makdishin velo maarichin velo macharimin velo magbihin [terumot umaserot] bazzeman hazze. im hikdish o heerich o hecherim o higbiah. hakkesut tissaref. habbehema teakker. [ketzad. noel befaneha haddelet vehi meta meeleha.] vehammaot yelchu leyam hammelach. avar vehikdish. min ma deamar ribbi shimon. bittelah rabban yochanan ben zakkay mippene hattekala. hada amra. avar vehikdish kadshu. ribbi yudan antodrayay bea kome ribbi yose. hacha at amar. kadshu vehacha at amar. lo kadshu. amar leh. tamman [lachen en makdishin lechattechilla lefi shemmitzva lehakeriv mitteruma chadasha veheaych haveya lah yeshana. vehacha may it lach lememar. hay yeshana hi. aval legabbe hekdeshot acherim kinno shel ger eno tzarich chadasha. veim hikdish. kadosh. veyanniach ad sheyyibbane vet hammikdash.] shemma yibbane habbayit kevarishona vetittarem terumat hallishka min hachadasha bizmannah beechad benisn. vehacha ma it lach. rav ada verav hamenune. rav ada bar achava veshem rav. halacha cheribbi shimon.
Shivat yamim kodem yom hakkippurim mafrishin kohen gadol mibbeto lelishkat parhedrin. umatkinin lo kohen acher tachtav shemma yeera bo pesul.
Rabbi yehuda omer: af ishsha acheret matkinin lo, shemma tamut ishto, shenneemar: "vechipper baado uvead beto", "beto" — zo ishto. amru lo: im ken, en laddavar sof.

Gemara tenan hatam: shivat yamim kodem serefat happara hayu mafrishin kohen hassoref et happara mibbeto lallishka sheal pene habbira tzafona mizracha, velishkat bet haeven hayta nikret. velamma nikra shemah lishkat bet haeven — shekkol maaseha bichle gelalim, bichle avanim, uvichle adama.
May tama? kevan ditvul yom kasher bappara, ditnan: metammein hayu hakkohen hassoref et happara umatbilin oto, lehotzi millibban shel tzaddukin, shehayu omrim: bimorve hashshemesh hayta naaset.
Takkinu la rabbanan: kele gelalim, kele avanim, uchele adama — dela likabbelu tumea, ki hechi dela lizalzelu ba.
May shena tzafona mizracha? kevan dechattat hi, vechattat teuna tzafona. uchetiv bah: "el nochach pene ohel moed" — takkinu la rabbanan lishka tzafona mizracha, ki hechi deleheve la hekkera.
May "bira"? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: makom haya behar habbayit uvira" shemo. veresh lakish amar: kol hammikdash kullo karuy "bira", shenneemar: "habbira asher hachinoti".

Mena hane mille? amar rav minyome bar chilkiyya amar rabbi machseya bar idi amar rabbi yochanan, amar kera: "kaasher asa bayyom hazze tzivva Adonai laasot lechapper alechem". "laasot" — ellu maase fara, "lechapper" — ellu maase yom hakkippurim.
Bishlama, kulleh kera befara lo mittokam — "lechapper" ketiv, ufara lav bat kappara hi. ella, ema kulleh kera beyom hakkippurim ketiv!

Amri: yalef "tzivva" "tzivva". ketiv hacha: "tzivva Adonai laasot", uchetiv hatam: "zot chukkat hattora asher tzivva Adonai lemor". ma lehallan para, af kan para. uma kan perisha, af lehallan perisha.
b: Veema, "tzivva" ["tzivva"] deyom hakkippurim, dichtiv: "vayyaas kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe"? danin "tzivva" delifne asiyya mitztzivva" delifne asiyya, veen danin "tzivva" dilachar asiyya mitztzivva" delifne asiyya.
Veema "tzivva" dekorbanot, dichtiv: "beyom tzavvoto et bene yisrael"? danin "tzivva" mitztzivva" veen danin "tzavvoto" mitztzivva".
Umay nafka minna? vehatana deve rabbi yishmael: "veshav hakkohen" "uva hakkohen", zo hi "shiva", zo hi "bia"!
Hane mille, hecha delekka dedame leh. aval hecha deikka dedame leh — middedame leh yalfinan.
"Lechapper" ellu maase yom hakkippurim. veema kappara dekorbanot!

Mi yadinan he kohen mitreme, devae leh perisha? amri, allema la?! nive leh perisha lechulleh mishmeret bet av! danin davar shekkavua lo zeman middavar shekkavua lo zeman, leappoke korbanot, dechol yoma itanhu.
Veema regalim! danin davar shennoheg paam achat bashshana middavar hannoheg paam achat bashshana, leappoke regalim, delav paam achat bashshana ninhu.
Veema regel echad! vechi tema: la yadinan he minnayyhu, i chag hammatztzot, hoil ufatach bo hakkatuv techilla, i chag hassukkot, hoil umerubba mitzvato!
Ella: danin perishat shiva leyom echad, mipperishat shiva leyom echad. veen danin perishat shiva leshiva, mipperishat shiva leyom echad.
Veema shemini, difrishat shiva leyom echad hu! danin davar sheen kedushsha lefanav middavar sheen kedushsha lefanav, veen danin davar sheyyesh kedushsha lefanav middavar sheen kedushsha lefanav.
Velav kal vachomer hu? hasheta davar sheen kedushsha lefanav bae perisha, davar sheyyesh kedushsha lefanav — la kol shekken! amar rav mesharsheya: la, "hazze" ketiv: kaze.
Rav ashe amar: mi ikka midde deikkar regel la bae perisha, tafel dideh bae perisha? vaafillu leman deamar shemini regel bifne atzmo hu, hane mille leinyan

a: Pazer keshev.
Aval leinyan tashlumin, tashlumin derishon hu, deha tenan: mi shello chag beyom tov harishon shel chag — chogeg veholech kol haregel kullo, veyom tov haacharon shel chag.
Veema atzeret, difrishat shiva leyom echad hu! amar rabbi abba: danin par echad veayil echad mippar echad veayil echad, leappoke atzeret dishne elim ninhu.

Hanicha leman deamar yom hakkippurim ayil echad hu, ella leman deamar shene elim ninhu, may ikka lememar! detanya, rabbi omer: ayil echad, hu haamur kan, hu haamur bechomesh happekudim. rabbi eliezer berabbi shimon omer: shene elim hem, echad haamur kan, veechad haamur bechomesh happekudim!
Afillu tema rabbi eliezer berabbi shimon: hatam chad lechovat hayyom, vechad lemusafin. leappoke atzeret, detarvayyhu chovat hayyom ninhu.

Veema rosh hashshana, difrishat shiva leyom echad hu! amar rabbi avahu: danin par vaayil shello mippar vaayil shello. leappoke atzeret verosh hashshana, detzibbur ninhu. hanicha leman deamar "kach lecha" — mishshellecha,
b: "Ase lecha" — mishshellecha, ella leman deamar mishshel tzibbur, may ikka lememar?

Detanya: "kach lecha" — mishshellecha, vaase lecha" — mishshellecha, "veyikchu elecha" — mishshel tzibbur, divre rabbi yoshiyya. rabbi yonatan omer: ben "kach lecha", ben "veyikchu elecha" — mishshel tzibbur, uma talmud lomar "kach lecha" — kivyachol mishshellecha ani rotze yoter mishshellahem.

Abba chanan amar mishshum rabbi elazar, katuv echad omer: "veasita lecha aron etz", vechatuv echad omer: "veasu aron atze shittim", ha ketzad? kan bizman sheyyisrael osin retzono shel makom, kan bizman sheen osin retzono shel makom!

Ad kan la peligi ella bekichot dealma vaasiyyot dealma. kichot dealma — "kach lecha sammim". asiyyot dealma — "ase lecha shete chatzotzrot kesef". aval hanach paroshe ka mefaresh demishshellecha hu. bemilluim mikkede ketiv: "veel bene yisrael tedabber lemor kechu seir izzim lechattat". "vayyomer el aharon kach lecha egel ben bakar lechattat" lema li? shema minna: "kach lecha" — mishshellecha hu.

Beyom hakkippurim mikkede ketiv: "bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh befar ben bakar lechattat vegomer ... umeet adat bene yisrael yikkach shene seire izzim lechattat". "vehikriv et par hachattat asher lo" lema li? shema minna: hay "lo" — mishshello hu.
Rav ashe amar: danin par lechattat veayil leola mippar lechattat veayil leola, leappoke rosh hashshana vaatzeret — detarvayyhu olot ninhu.
Ravina amar: danin avoda bechohen gadol meavoda bechohen gadol, leappoke kullehu kusheyaytin — delav avoda bechohen gadol ninhu.

Veikka deamri amar ravina: danin avoda techilla meavoda techilla, leappoke hane — delav techilla ninhu. may techilla? illema techilla bechohen gadol — hayeynu kammayyta. ella, avoda techilla bammakom meavoda techilla bammakom.

Ki ata rav dimi, amar: rabbi yochanan matne chada, [rabbi yehoshua ben levi] matne tarte. rabbi yochanan matne chada: "laasot lechapper" — ellu maase yom hakkippurim. [vihoshua ben levi] matne tarte: "laasot" — ellu maase fara, "lechapper" — ellu maase yom hakkippurim.
Rabbi yochanan matne chada? veha anan tenan: shivat yamim kodem yom hakkippurim, veshivat yamim kodem serefat happara! maala bealma.

Veha amar rabbi minyome bar chilkiyya amar rabbi machseya bar idde amar rabbi yochanan: "kaasher asa bayyom hazze tzivva Adonai laasot lechapper alechem", "laasot" — ellu maase fara, "lechapper" — ellu maase yom hakkippurim! hahu derabbeh. dechi ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yishmael: "laasot" — ellu maase fara, "lechapper" — ellu maase yom hakkippurim.
Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: mehecha ka yalfat la — mimmilluim, i ma milluim kol hakkatuv bahen meakkev bahen, af hacha name — kol hakkatuv bahen meakkev bahen.
Vechi tema hachi name, vehatnan: "umatkinin lo kohen acher", vela katane "mafrishin"! vechi tema: may "matkinin" — "mafrishin", litne o idde veidde "matkinin", o idde veidde "mafrishin".

Amar leh: ella mar mehecha yalef la? amar: missinay, dichtiv: "vayyishkon kevod Adonai al har sinay vaychassehu heanan sheshet yamim vayyikra el moshe bayyom hashshevii", mikkede ketiv: "vayyikra el moshe bayyom hashshevii", may "sheshet yamim"? ze bana av: shekkol hannichnas bemachane shechina, taun perishat shishsha.
Veha anan shiva tenan! matnitin rabbi yehuda ben betera hi, dechayesh

a: Letumeat beto.

Amar leh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: bishlama ledidi deyalefna mimmilluim, hayeynu detanya: ze veze mazzin alav kol shiva mikkol chattaot shehayu sham, dahavay name hazzaa bemilluim. ella ledidach deyalfat missinay, hazzaa besinay mi havay?
Amar leh: uletamaych mi nicha? bemilluim dam, hacha mayim! ha la kashya, detane rabbi chiyyay: nichnesu mayim tachat dam. ella ledidach, hazzaa besinay mi havay? amar leh: maala bealma.

Tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan, tanya kevoteh deresh lakish. tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan: "bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh", bema sheamur bainyan, may hi — beinyan demilluim. uma amur beinyan demilluim — aharon perash shiva veshimmesh yom echad, umoshe masar lo kol shiva kede lechannecho baavoda.
Veaf ledorot kohen gadol poresh shiva umeshammesh yom echad, ushene talmide chachamim mittalmidav shel moshe — leappoke tzaddukin, mosrin lo kol shiva kede lechannecho baavoda.

Mikkan amru: shivat yamim kodem yom hakkippurim mafrishin kohen gadol mibbeto lelishkat parhedrin. ucheshem shemmafrishin kohen gadol, kach mafrishin kohen hassoref et happara lallishka sheal pene habbira tzafona mizracha. veechad ze veechad ze mazzin alav kol shiva mikkol chattaot shehayu sham.

Veim tomar: bemilluim dam, hacha mayim, amarta: nichnesu mayim tachat dam. veomer "kaasher asa bayyom hazze tzivva Adonai laasot lechapper alechem". "laasot" — ellu maase fara, "lechapper" — ellu maase yom hakkippurim.
Vehay "bezot" mibbee leh legufeh, befar ben bakar lechattat veayil leola! amri: i lekorban lechodeh, lema kera "beze" o "beelle", may "bazot" — shamat minna tarte.

May "veomer"? vechi tema: yom hakkippurim kamma hu devae perisha, kidashkechan bemilluim aval beyom hakkippurim dealma la. i name: kohen gadol kamma hu devae perisha, aval kohen gadol bealma la, ta shema: "kaasher asa vechulei".

Tanya kevoteh deresh lakish: moshe ala beanan, venitkassa beanan, venitkaddesh beanan, kede lekabbel tora leyisrael bikdushsha, shenneemar: "vayyishkon kevod Adonai al har sinay" — ze haya maase achar aseret haddibberot, shehayu techilla learbaim yom, divre rabbi yose haggelili.
Rabbi akiva omer: "vayyishkon kevod Adonai" — merosh chodesh.
b: "Vaychassehu heanan", lahar. "vayyikra el moshe" — [moshe] vechol yisrael omdin, velo ba hakkatuv ella lachlok kavod lemoshe. rabbi natan omer: lo ba hakkatuv ella lemarek achila ushetiyya shebbemeav, lesumo kemalache hashsharet.

Rabbi matya ben charash omer: lo ba hakkatuv ella leayyem alav, kede shettehe tora nittenet beema, birtet uvezia, shenneemar: "ivdu et Adonai beyira vegilu birada". may "vegilu birada"? amar rav adda bar matna amar rav: bimkom gila sham tehe reada.

Bemay ka mippalgi rabbi yose haggelili verabbi akiva? biflugeta dehane tannae, detanya: beshishsha bachodesh nittena tora leyisrael, rabbi yose omer: beshiva bo. man deamar beshishsha: beshishsha nittena, uveshiva ala (dichtiv: "vayyikra el moshe bayyom hashshevii"). man deamar beshiva: beshiva nittena, uveshiva ala, [dichtiv: "vayyikra el moshe bayyom hashshevii"].

Rabbi yose haggelili savar la ketanna kamma, deamar beshishsha bachodesh nittena tora, hilkach ze haya maase achar aseret haddibberot. "vayyishkon kevod Adonai al har sinay vaychassehu heanan sheshet yamim" — lemoshe, "vayyikra el moshe bayyom hashshevii" — lekabbole shear tora. dei salka datach "vayyishkon kevod Adonai" merosh chodesh, "vaychassehu heanan lahar vayyikra el moshe bayyom hashshevii" lekabbole aseret haddibberot, ha kabbilu lehu mishshishsha, veha istallak anan mishshishsha!

Verabbi akiva savar la kerabbi yose, deamar: beshiva bachodesh nittena tora leyisrael. bishlama lerabbi akiva, hayeynu demashkachat la beshiva asar betammuz nishtabberu halluchot: esrin vearbea desivan, veshittesar detammuz, malu lehu arbein yomin dahava bahar, uveshivsar betammuz nechet vaata vetavrinhu leluchot.
Ella lerabbi yose haggelili, deamar: shishsha difrisha vearbein dehar, ad esrin utelat betammuz la ittabbur luchot! amar lecha rabbi yose haggelili: arbein dehar bahade shishsha difrisha.

Amar mar: "vayyikra el moshe" — moshe vechol yisrael omdin, mesayyay leh lerabbi elazar. deamar rabbi elazar: "vayyikra el moshe" — moshe vechol yisrael omdin, velo ba hakkatuv ella lachlok lo kavod lemoshe.
Metivi: "kol lo", "kol elav" — moshe shama vechol yisrael lo shamu! la kashya: ha — besinay, ha — beohel moed. vei baet ema, la kashya: ha — bikria, ha — bedibbur.

Rabbi zerika rame kerae kammeh derabbi elazar, veamri la amar rabbi zerika: rabbi elazar rame, ketiv: "velo yachol moshe lavo el ohel moed ki shachan alav heanan", uchetiv: "vayyavo moshe betoch heanan"! melammed shettefaso hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe vehevio beanan.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: neemar kan "betoch", veneemar lehallan "betoch" — "veyavou vene yisrael betoch hayyam". ma lehallan shevil, dichtiv: "vehammayim lahem choma", af kan shevil.

"Vayyikra el moshe vaydabber", lamma hikdim keria ledibbur? limmeda tora derech eretz, shello yomar adam davar lachavero ella im ken korehu. mesayyay leh lerabbi chanina. deamar rabbi chanina: lo yomar adam davar lachavero ella im ken korehu. "lemor", amar rabbi (museya bar bereh derabbi masya mishshemeh derabbi museya) rabba: minnayin laomer davar lachavero shehu beval yomar ad sheyyomar lo: lech emor — shenneemar: "vaydabber Adonai elav meohel moed lemor".

Michlal detarvavyyhu sevira lehu milluim kol hakkatuv bahen meakkev bahen. deittemar: milluim, rabbi yochanan verabbi chanina, chad amar: kol hakkatuv bahen meakkev bahen, vechad amar: davar hameakkev ledorot — meakkev bahen, sheen meakkev ledorot — en meakkev bahen.

Tistayyem derabbi yochanan hu deamar kol hakkatuv bahen meakkev bahen. middekaamar leh rabbi shimon ben lakish lerabbi yochanan: i ma milluim kol hakkatuv bahen meakkev bahen, vela ka mahdar leh vela midde. tistayyem.
May benayyhu?

a: Amar rav yosef: semicha ikka benayyhu. leman deamar kol hakkatuv bahen meakkev bahen — semicha meakkeva, leman deamar davar sheen meakkev ledorot en meakkev bahen — semicha la meakkeva.
Uledorot mena lan dela meakkeva? detanya: "vesamach" "venirtza". vechi semicha mechapperet? vahalo en kappara ella bedam, shenneemar: "ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper"!
Uma talmud lomar "vesamach" "venirtza"? sheim asaah lismicha sheyare mitzva — maale alav hakkatuv keillu lo kipper, vechipper!
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: tenufa ikka benayyhu. leman deamar kol hakkatuv bahen meakkev bahen — meakkeva. uleman deamar davar sheen meakkev ledorot en meakkev bahen — la meakkeva.

Uledorot mena lan dela meakkeva? detanya: "litnufa lechapper". vechi tenufa mechapperet? vahalo en kappara ella bedam, shenneemar: "ki haddam hu bannefesh yechapper"! uma talmud lomar "litnufa lechapper"? sheim asaah litnufa sheyare mitzva — maale alav hakkatuv keillu lo kipper, vechipper.
Rav pappa amar: perishat shiva ikka benayyhu. leman deamar kol hakkatuv bahen meakkev bahen — meakkeva. leman deamar davar sheeno meakkev ledorot eno meakkev bahen — la meakkeva.
Uledorot mena lan dela meakkeva? middeka tane "matkinin", vela katane "mafrishin".
Ravina amar: ribbuy shiva umeshicha shiva, ikka benayyhu. leman deamar kol hakkatuv bahen meakkev bahen — meakkeva. leman deamar davar sheen meakkev ledorot en meakkev bahen — la meakkeva.
Uledorot mena lan dela meakkeva? detanya: "vechipper hakkohen asher yimshach oto vaasher yemalle et yado lechahen tachat aviv", ma talmud lomar?

Lefi shenneemar: "shivat yamim yilbasham hakkohen tachtav mibbanav", en li ella nitrabba shiva venimshach shiva. nitrabba shiva venimshach yom echad, nitrabba yom echad venimshach shiva minnayin? talmud lomar: "asher yimshach oto vaasher yemalle et yado" — mikkol makom.
Ashkechan ribbuy shiva lechattechilla, meshicha shiva lechattechilla mena lan?

Ibbaet ema middeitzterich kera lemaota. veibbaet ema deamar kera: "uvigde hakkodesh asher leaharon yihyu levanav acharav lemoshcha vahem ulemalle vam et yadam", ittakkash meshicha leribbuy: ma ribbuy shiva, af meshicha shiva.
May tama deman deamar kol hakkatuv bahen meakkev? amar rabbi yitzchak bar bisna, amar kera: "veasita leaharon ulevanav kacha". "kacha" ikkuva hu. tinach kol
b: Milleta dichtiva behay inyana. milleta dela ketiva behay inyana mena lan?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: yalef "petach" "petach". rav mesharsheya amar: "ushemartem et mishmeret Adonai" — ikkuva. rav ashe amar: "ki chen tzuvveti" — ikkuva.

Tanu rabbanan: "ki chen tzuvveti", "kaasher tzivveti", "kaasher tzivva Adonai". "ki chen tzuvveti" — baaninut yochluha. "kaasher tzivveti" — bishat maase amar lahem. "kaasher tzivva Adonai" — velo meelay ani omer.
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina: michnasayim en ketuvin bapparasha, keshehu omer "veze haddavar asher taase lahem lekaddesh otam lechahen" — lehavi hammichnasayim vaasirit haefa.
Bishlama michnasayim ketivi beinyana divgadim, ella asirit haefa mena lan? atya "ze" "ze" mivveze korban aharon uvanav asher yakrivu laAdonai asirit haefa".
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: minnayin sheaf mikra parasha meakkev, talmud lomar: "vayyomer moshe el haeda ze haddavar asher tzivva Adonai" — afillu dibbur meakkev.
Ketzad hilbishan? ketzad hilbishan?! may dahava hava! ella: ketzad malbishan leatid lavo? leatid lavo name, lichsheyyavou aharon uvanav umoshe immahem!
Ella: ketzad hilbishan lemisbar kerae. peligi bah bene rabbi chiyyay verabbi yochanan. chad amar: aharon veachar kach banav, vechad amar: aharon uvanav bevat achat.

Amar abbaye: bechuttonet umitznefet kulle alma la peligi deaharon veachar kach banav. deven betzauoa uven baasiyya aharon kadem. ki peligi beavnet. man deamar aharon veachar kach banav, dichtiv: "vayyachgor oto baavnet", vahadar ketiv: "vayyachgor otam avnet". uman deamar aharon uvanav bevat achat, dichtiv: "vechagarta otam". uleman deamar aharon uvanav bevat achat, hachtiv: "vayyachgor oto beavnet" vahadar ketiv: "vayyachgor otam avnet"!

a: Amar lach: hahu avneto shel kohen gadol lo ze hu avneto shel kohen hedyot.
Uleman deamar aharon veachar kach banav, vehachtiv: "vechagarta otam avnet"! amar lach: hahu ka mashma lan, avneto shel kohen gadol zehu avneto shel kohen hedyot.
"Vayyachgor oto avnet" "vayyachgor otam" lema li? shema minna aharon veachar kach banav. uvevat achat mi mashkachat la? la tzericha, deakdem.
Mafrishin kohen gadol vechulei. lamma mafrishin? lamma mafrishin?! kidkaamrinan, i lerabbi yochanan kidit leh, i leresh lakish kidit leh!
Hachi kaamar: mibbeto lamma perash? tanya: rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: shemma timmatze ishto safek nidda veyavo aleha.
Attu berashshie askinan? ella: shemma yavo al ishto vetimmatze safek nidda.
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derav chisda: keman — kerabbi akiva, deamar: nidda metammea et boalah. dei rabbanan, ha amri: en nidda metammea et boalah.
Amar lehu rav chisda: afillu temru rabbanan, ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi akiva ella beachar achar, aval bechad achar — modu leh.
Amar rabbi zera: shema minna boel nidda eno kenidda, vetovel bayyom.
Dei amrat boel nidda kenidda, emat tavel — belelya. limchar hechi aved avoda? veha bae heerev hashshemesh. ella lav shema minna boel nidda eno kenidda.
Rav shimi minnehardea amar: afillu tema boel nidda kenidda, demafreshinan leh shaa achat samuch lishkiat hachamma.
Metivi: kol chayyayve tevilot tevilatan bayyom, nidda veyoledet tevilatan ballayla. nidda in, boel nidda la!
Nidda vechol deate meribbuyay.
Metivi: baal keri kemagga sheretz, boel nidda kitme met. may lav litvila? lo, letumeatan.
Tumeatan?! behedya ketiv behu. hay tumeat shiva ketiv beh, vehay tumeat shiva ketiv beh,
b: Ella lav, litvilatan!
La, leolam letumeatan, sefa itztericha leh: ella shechamur mimmennu boel nidda, shemmetamme mishkav umoshav betumea kalla, letamme ochalin umashkin.
Ta shema, detane rabbi chiyyay: hazzav vehazzava vehammetzora vehametzoraat uvoel nidda uteme met tevilatan bayyom, nidda veyoledet tevilatan ballayla! teyuveta.
Vead sheatta mafrisho mittumeat beto, haferishehu mittumeat hammet! amar rav tachlifa avu derav huna (bar tachlifa) mishshemeh derava: zot omeret: tumeat hammet huttera hi betzibbur.
Ravina amar: afillu tema tumeat hammet dechuya hi betzibbur. tumeat hammet la shechicha, tumeat beto shechicha.
Ittemar, tumeat hammet, rav nachman amar: huttera hi betzibbur, verav sheshet amar: dechuya hi betzibbur.
Hecha deikka temein utehorin behahu bet av — kulle alma la peligi dithorin avdi, temein la avdi. ki peligi leahdore uleetoye tehorin mibbet av acharina.
Rav nachman amar: hetter hi betzibbur, vela mahderinan. verav sheshet amar: dechuya hi betzibbur, umahderinan.
Ikka deamri: afillu hecha deikka tehorin utemein behahu bet av pelig rav nachman, veamar: avdi name temein,

a: Dechol tumeat met betzibbur rachamana sharyay.
Amar rav sheshet: mena amena la, detanya: haya omed umakriv minchat haomer venitmet beyado, omer umeviin acheret tachteha. veim en sham ella hi, omrin lo: heve pikkeach ushetok.
Katane mihat omer umeviin acheret tachteha! amar rav nachman: modena hecha deikka shirayim laachila.
Metivi: haya makriv minchat parim veelim uchevasim, venitmet beyado, omer umeviin acheret tachteha. veim en sham ella hi, omrin lo: heve pikkeach ushetok.
May lav, parim elim uchevasim dechag!

Amar lecha rav nachman: la: parim — par avoda zara, af al gav detzibbur hu, kevan dela kevia leh zeman — mahderinan. elim — beelo shel aharon, deaf al gav dikvia leh zeman, kevan deyachid hu — mehadderinan. kevasim — becheves habba im haomer, deikka shirayim laachila.
Metivi: dam shennitma uzerako, beshogeg — huretza, bemezid — lo huretza. ki tanya hahi deyachid.

Ta shema: al ma hatztzitz meratztze, al haddam veal habbasar veal hachelev shennitma, ben beshogeg ben bemezid, ben beones ben beratzon, ben beyachid ben betzibbur. vei salka datach tumea hetter hi betzibbur — lema li leratztzoye?
Amar lecha rav nachman: ki katane "hatztzitz meratztze" addeyachid. veibbaet ema: afillu tema betzibbur, behanach dela kevia lah zeman.
Metivi: "venasa aharon et avon hakkodashim", vechi eze avon hu nose? im avon piggul — hare kevar neemar: "lo yeratze", veim avon notar — hare kevar neemar: "lo yechashev",
b: Ha eno nose ella avon tumea shehuttera mikkelalah betzibbur. vekashya lerav sheshet! tannae hi. detanya: tzitz, ben sheyyeshno al mitzcho ben sheeno al mitzcho — meratztze, divre rabbi shimon.
Rabbi yehuda omer: odehu al mitzcho — meratztze. en odehu al mitzcho — eno meratztze. amar lo rabbi shimon: kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim yochiach, sheen odehu al mitzcho, umeratztze!
Amar lo rabbi yehuda: hannach lechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim, shettumea huttera lo betzibbur. mikkelal derabbi shimon savar tumea dechuya hi betzibbur.
Amar abbaye: benishbar hatztzitz dechulle alma la peligi dela meratztze. ki peligi ditle besikketa, rabbi yehuda savar: "al metzach ... venasa",
Verabbi shimon savar "tamid leratzon lifne Adonai". may "tamid"? illema: tamid al mitzcho, mi mashkachat la?! mi la bae meal levet hakkisse, umi la bae menam?! ella: tamid meratztze hu.

Ulerabbi yehuda name, ha ketiv "tamid"! hahu tamid shello yassiach dato mimmennu, kidrabba bar rav huna. deamar rabba bar rav huna: chayyayv adam lemashmesh bitfillav bechol shaa veshaa, kal vachomer mitztzitz:

a: Uma tzitz, sheen bo ella azkara achat, amra tora: "al mitzcho tamid" — shello yassiach dato mimmennu. tefillin sheyyesh bahen azkarot harebe — al achat kamma vechamma.
Ulerabbi shimon deamar tamid meratztze, veha ketiv "al mitzcho venasa"! hahu likboa lo makom hu daata.
Verabbi yehuda likboa lo makom mena leh? nafka leh meal mitzcho". verabbi shimon name, tippok leh meal mitzcho"? in hachi name.
Ella, "al mitzcho venasa" may aved leh? amar lach: rauy lammetzach meratztze, sheeno rauy lammetzach eno meratztze. leappoke nishbar hatztzitz, delo meratztze.
Ulerabbi yehuda, nishbar hatztzitz mena leh? nafka leh mimmetzach" "mitzcho". verabbi shimon, "metzach" "mitzcho" la mashma leh.

Nema hane tannae kehane tannae. detanya: echad ze veechad ze mazzin alav kol shiva mikkol chattaot shehayu sham — divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: en mazzin alav ella shelishi ushevii bilvad. rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer: kohen hassoref et happara mazzin alav kol shiva, kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim en mazzin alav ella shelishi ushevii.
May lav beha ka mippalgi, rabbi meir savar: tumea dechuya hi betzibbur. verabbi yose savar: tumea hetter hi betzibbur.
Vetisbera? i savar rabbi yose hetter hi betzibbur — hazzaa kelal lema li? ella dechulle alma hane tannae savri tumea dechuya hi betzibbur.
Vehacha beha kamippalgi, rabbi meir savar: amrinan tevila bizmannah mitzva. verabbi yose savar: la amrinan tevila bizmannah mitzva.

Vesavar rabbi yose la amrinan tevila bizmannah mitzva? vehatanya: hare shehaya shem katuv al besaro — hare ze lo yirchatz velo yasuch velo yaamod bimkom hattinnofet. nizdammena lo tevila shel mitzva — korech alav gemi vetovel. rabbi yose omer: yored vetovel kedarko, uvilvad shello yeshafshef.

Vekayyma lan devitvila bizmannah mitzva ka mippalgi, detanna kamma savar: la amrinan tevila bizmannah mitzva, verabbi yose savar: amrinan tevila bizmannah mitzva. ella, dechulle alma lehane tannae amrinan tevila bizmannah mitzva.
Vehacha beha kamippalgi, rabbi meir savar: makkeshinan hazzaa litvila, verabbi yose savar: la makkeshinan hazzaa litvila.
Verabbi chanina segan hakkohanim? i makkesh hazzaa litvila — afillu kohen beyom hakkippurim name, i la makkesh hazzaa litvila — afillu kohen hassoref et happara name la!
Leolam la makkesh, vechohen hassoref et happara maala bealma.
Keman azla ha detanu rabbanan: en ben kohen hassoref et happara lechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim ella
b: Shezze perishato likdushsha veechav hakkohanim nogin bo, veze perishato letohora veen echav hakkohanim nogin bo. keman — o rabbi meir o rabbi yose. dei rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim — ha ikka name ha.

Matkef la rabbi yose berabbi chanina: bishlama rishon — shemma shelishi. sheni — shemma shelishi. shelishi — shemma shelishi. chamishi — shemma shevii. shishshi — shemma shevii. shevii — shemma shevii.
Ella revii lema li hazzaa kelal? la bishlishi ikka lesappoke, velo bishvii ikka lesappoke?
Uletamaych, hazzaa kol shiva mi ikka? veha kayyma lan dehazzaa shevut veenah docha et hashshabbat! ella may it lach lememar — shiva levar mishshabbat, hacha name — shiva levar mervii.

Amar rava: hilkach kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim, dela bedidan talya milleta, ella bikvia deyarcha talya milleta — bitlata betishri bae leafroshe, vechol emat demitreme telata betishri mafreshinan leh. aval kohen hassoref et happara, divdidan talya milleta — mafreshinan leh birvii beshabbat, ki hechi denitreme revii shello beshabbat.
Lelishkat parhedrin. tanya rabbi yehuda: vechi lishkat parhedrin hayta? vahalo lishkat balvote hayta!

Ella, battechilla hayu korin otah lishkat balvote. umittoch shennotnin alav mamon lakkehunna, umachalifin otah kol shenem asar chodesh kefarhedrin hallalu shemmachlifin otam kol shenem asar chodesh, lefichach hayu korin otah lishkat parhedrin.
Tenan hatam: hannachtomin — lo chiyyeyvu otan chachamim lehaferish ella terumat maaser vechalla.
Bishlama teruma gedola la, detanya:

a: Lefi sheshshalach bechol gevule yisrael, veraa sheen mafrishin ella teruma gedola bilvad.
Maaser rishon umasar ani name la, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. ella maaser sheni, nafreshu venasseku venechlu birushalayim?
Amar ulla: mittoch shepparhedrin hallalu chovtin otan kol shenem asar chodesh, veomrim lahen: michru bezol! michru bezol! la atrechunehu rabbanan. may parhedrin? purese.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv: "yirat Adonai tosif yamim ushenot reshaim tiktzorna", "yirat Adonai tosif yamim" ze mikdash rishon sheamad arba meot veeser shanim, velo shimmeshu bo ella shemona asar kohanim gedolim,

"Ushenot reshaim tiktzorna" ze mikdash sheni, sheamad arba meot veesrim shana veshimmeshu bo yoter mishshelosh meot kohanim. tze mehem arbaim shana sheshshimmesh shimon hatztzaddik, ushemonim sheshshimmesh yochanan kohen gadol, eser sheshshimmesh yishmael ben piavi, veamri la achat esre sheshshimmesh rabbi elazar ben charsom, mikkan veelach tze vachashov: kol echad veechad lo hotzi shenato.

Amar rabbi yochanan ben torta: mippene ma charva shilo — mippene shehayu bah shene devarim: gilluy arayot, uvizyon kodashim. gilluy arayot dichtiv: "veeli zaken meod veshama et kol asher yaasun banav lechol yisrael veet asher yishkevun et hannashim hatztzovot petach ohel moed". veaf al gav deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yochanan: kol haomer bene eli chatu eno ella toe, mittoch
b: Sheshshihu et kinnehen, miha maale alehen hakkatuv keillu shechavum.

Bizyon kodashim, dichtiv: "gam beterem yaktirun et hachelev uva naar hakkohen veamar laish hazzoveach tena vasar litzlot lakkohen velo yikkach mimmecha basar mevushshal ki im chay. vayyomer elav haish katter yaktirun kayyom hachelev vekach lecha kaasher teavve nafshecha veamar lo ki atta titten veim lo lakachti vechozka. vattehi chattat hannearim gedola meod et pene Adonai ki niatzu haanashim et minchat Adonai".
Mikdash rishon mippene ma charav — mippene shelosha devarim shehayu bo: avoda zara, vegilluy arayot, ushefichut damim. avoda zara, dichtiv: "ki katzar hammatztza mehistarea".
May "katzar hammatztza mehistarea"? amar rabbi yonatan: katzar matztza ze mehistarer alav shene reim keechad.
"Vehammassecha tzara kehitkannes", amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani: ki mate rabbi yonatan lehay kera bache, amar: man dichtiv beh "kones kanned me hayyam", naaset lo massecha tzara?

Gilluy arayot, dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai yaan ki gavhu benot tziyyon vattelachna netuyot garon umesakkerot enayim haloch vetafof telachna uveraglehen teakkasna". "yaan ki gavhu benot tziyyon" — shehayu mehallechot arukka betzad ketzara. "vattelachna netuyot garon" — shehayu mehallechot bekoma zekufa. "umesakkerot enayim" — dahavo malyayn kuchela enehen. "haloch vetafof telachna" — shehayu mehallechot akev betzad gudal. "uveraglehen teakkasna" — amar rabbi yitzchak: shehayu meviot mor vaafarsemon umannichot beminalehen, ucheshemmaggiot etzel bachure yisrael boatot umattizot alehen, umachnisin bahen yetzer hara keeres bechaus.
Shefichut damim, dichtiv: "vegam dam naki shafach menashshe [harebe meod] ad asher mille et yerushalam pe lafe".

Aval mikdash sheni shehayu oskin betora uvemitzvot ugemilut chasadim, mippene ma charav? mippene shehayta bo sinat chinnam. lelammedcha sheshshekula sinat chinnam keneged shalosh averot: avoda zara, gilluy arayot, ushefichut damim.

Reshaim hayu, ella shettalu bitchonam behakkadosh baruch hu. atan lemikdash rishon, dichtiv: "rasheha beshochad yishpotu vechohaneha bimchir yoru unevieha bechesef yiksomu veal Adonai yishshaenu lemor halo Adonai bekirbenu lo tavo alenu raa". lefichach hevi alehen hakkadosh baruch hu shalosh gezerot keneged shalosh averot shebbeyadam, shenneemar: "lachen biglalchem tziyyon sade techaresh virushalaym iyyin tihye vehar habbayit levamot yaar".

Uvemikdash rishon la hava beh sinat chinnam? vehachtiv: "megure el cherev hayu et ammi lachen sefok el yarech", veamar rabbi (eliezer): ellu bene adam sheochlin veshotin ze im ze vedokrin ze et ze bacharavot shebbilshonam.
Hahi binsie yisrael havay, dichtiv: "zeak vehelel ben adam ki hi hayta veammi", vetanya: "zeak vehelel ben adam", yachol lakkol? talmud lomar: "hi bechol nesie yisrael".
Rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvavyyhu: rishonim shennitgalla avonam — nitgalla kitztzam. acharonim shello nitgalla avonam — lo nitgalla kitztzam.

Amar rabbi yochanan: tova tzippornan shel rishonim, mikkereso shel acharonim. amar leh resh lakish: adderabba acharonim adifi, af al gav deikka shibud malchiyyot — ka aski betora. amar leh: bira tochiach, shechazra larishonim velo chazra laacharonim.
Shaalu et rabbi elazar: rishonim gedolim, o acharonim gedolim? amar lahem: tenu enechem babbira. ikka deamri, amar lahem: edechem bira,

Resh lakish have sache beyardena ata rabba bar bar chana yehav leh yeda. amar leh: elaha! sanena lechu — dichtiv: "im choma hi nivne aleha tirat kasef veim delet hi natzur aleha luach arez". im asitem atzmechem kechoma vaalitem kullechem bime ezra — nimshaltem kechesef sheen rakav sholet bo, achshav shealitem kidlatot — nimshaltem keerez sheharakav sholet bo.

May erez? amar ulla: sasmagor. may sasmagor? amar rabbi abba: bat kol. kidtanya: mishshemmetu neviim haacharonim chaggay zecharya umalachi nistalleka ruach hakkodesh miyyisrael, vaadayin hayu mishtammeshin bevat kol.

Veresh lakish, mi mishtae bahade rabba bar bar chana? uma rabbi (eliezer), demara deara deyisrael hava, vela hava mishtae resh lakish bahadeh, deman demishtae resh lakish bahadeh beshuka, yahavu leh iska bela sahade — bahade rabba bar bar chana mishtae?!

Amar rav pappa, shedi gavra benayyhu: o resh lakish hava uzeeri, o rabba bar bar chana hava verabbi elazar. ki ata lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amar leh: lav hayeynu tama, i name seliku kullehu bime ezra la hava sharya shechina bemikdash sheni, dichtiv: "yaft elohim leyefet veyishkon beohole shem",

a: Af al gav deyaft elohim leyefet" — en hashshechina shora ella beohole shem.

Ufarsae mena lan demiyyefet kaatu, dichtiv: "bene yefet gomer umagog umaday veyavan vetuval umeshech vetiras". gomer — ze germamya, magog — zo kandiyya, maday — zo makedonya, yavan — kemashmao, tuval — ze bet unayyki, meshech — zo museya, tiras, peligi ba rabbi simay verabbanan, veamri la rabbi simon verabbanan, chad amar: zo bet terayyki, vechad amar: zo paras. tane rav yosef: tiras — zo paras.
"Savta verama vesavtecha", tane rav yosef: sakkistan gavvayyta vesakkistan barayyta, ben chada lachada mea parse, vehekkefa alpa parse.
"Vattehi reshit mamlachto bavel veerech veakkad vechalne", bavel — kemashmea, erech — ze orichut, veakkad — ze bashkar, kalne — ze nufar ninfi.

"Min haaretz hahi yatza ashshur", tane rav yosef: ashshur — ze silak. "vayyiven et ninve veet rechovot ir veet kalach", ninve — kemashmao, rechovot ir — zo perat demeshan, kalach — zo perat devorsif. "veet resen ben ninve uven kalach hi hair haggedola", resen — ze aktisfon. "hi hair haggedola" — eni yodea im ninve hair haggedola, im resen hair haggedola. keshehu omer "veninve hayta ir gedola lelohim mahalach sheloshet yamim", heve omer: ninve hi hair haggedola.

"Vesham achiman sheshay vetalmay yelide haanak", tana: achiman — meyumman shebbaachim, sheshay — shemmesim et haaretz kishchitot, talmay — shemmesim et haaretz telamim telamim. davar acher: achiman bana anat, sheshay bana alush, talmay bana talbush. "yelide haanak" — shemmaanikin hachamma bekomatan.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar rabbi: atida romi shettippol beyad paras, shenneemar: "lachen shimu atzat Adonai asher yaatz (al) edom umachshevotav asher chashav (al) yoshve teman im lo yischavum tzeire hatztzon im lo yashshim alehem nevehem".

Matkef la rabba bar ulla: may mashma dehay "tzeire hatztzon" paras hu — dichtiv: "haayil asher raita baal hakkeranayim (hu) malche maday ufaras". veema yavan, dichtiv: "vehatztzafir hassair melech yavan"!

Ki selek rav chaviva bar sormaki, amra kammeh dehahu merabbanan, amar leh: man dela yada paroshe kerae motev teyuveta lerabbi?! may "tzeire hatztzon" — zutera daachohi. detane rav yosef: tiras — ze paras.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay: atida romi shettippol beyad paras, kal vachomer: uma mikdash rishon shebbenauhu bene shem vehechrivuhu kasdiyyim — naflu kasdiyyim beyad parsiyyim. mikdash sheni shebbenauhu parsiyyim vehechrivuhu romiyyim — eno din sheyyippelu romiyyim beyad parsiyyim?

Amar rav: atida paras shettippol beyad romi. amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav: banoye beyad satore?! amar lehu: in, gezerat melech hi. ikka deamri, amar (leh): inhu name ha ka satri be chenishta.

Tanya name hachi: atida paras shettippol beyad romi, chada — desatri be chenishta, veod: gezerat melech hu sheyyippelu bonin beyad sotrin. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: en ben david ba ad shettifshot malchut romi harshaa bechol haolam kullo tisha chodashim, shenneemar: "lachen yittenem ad et yoleda yalada veyeter echav yeshuvun al bene yisrael".
Tanu rabbanan: kol halleshachot shehayu bemikdash lo hayu lahen mezuza, chutz millishkat parhedrin, shehaya bah bet dira lechohen gadol.
Amar rabbi yehuda: vahalo kamma leshachot hayu bemikdash shehaya lahen bet dira, velo haya lahen mezuza? ella lishkat parhedrin gezera hayta.

May tama derabbi yehuda? amar (rava): kasavar rabbi yehuda: kol bayit sheeno asuy limot hachamma velimot haggeshamim — eno bayit. etiveh abbaye, vehachtiv: "vehikketi (et) bet hachoref al bet hakkayitz"! amar leh: "bet choref" uvet kayitz" ikkeri, "bayit" setama la ikkeri.
Etiveh abbaye: sukkat hechag bechag, rabbi yehuda mechayyev vachachamim potrin. vetane ala: rabbi yehuda mechayyev beeruv uvimzuza uvemaaser!
Vechi tema midderabbanan, bishlama eruv umezuza ikka lememar midderabbanan, ella maaser, mi ikka lememar midderabbanan?
b: Dilma ate leafroshe min hachiyyuv al happetur umin happetur al hachiyyuv.
Ella amar abbaye: beshiva — dechulle alma la peligi demichayyeyva. ki peligi bishar yemot hashshana. rabbanan savri: gazrinan shear yemot hashshana attu shiva, verabbi yehuda savar: la gazrinan.
Amar leh rava: veha sukkat hechag bechag katane?
Ella amar rava: bishar yemot hashshana kulle alma la peligi diftura. ki peligi beshiva. vesukka tama lechud, velishka tama lechud.
Sukka tama lechud — rabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: sukka dirat keva baenan, umichayyeyva bimzuza. verabbanan letamayyhu, deamri: sukka dirat aray baenan, vela michayyeyva bimzuza.

Velishka tama lechud, rabbanan savri: dira beal korchah shemah dira. verabbi yehuda savar: dira beal korchah lo shemah dira, umidderabbanan hu detakkinu la, shello yomru: kohen gadol chavush bevet haasurin.
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan:

a: Kol hashshearim shehayu sham lo haya lahem mezuza, chutz mishshaar nikanor, shellifnim mimmennu lishkat parhedrin.
Lema rabbanan hi vela rabbi yehuda? dei rabbi yehuda, hi gufa gezera, vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera? afillu tema rabbi yehuda, kulla chada gezera hi.

Tanu rabbanan: "bisharecha" — echad shaare vattim veechad shaare chatzerot veechad shaare medinot veechad shaare ayayrot yesh bahen chovat mitzva lammakom, mishshum shenneemar: "uchetavtam al mezuzot betecha uvisharecha".

Amar leh abbaye lerav safra: hane avulle demachoza may tama la avadu lehu rabbanan mezuza? amar leh: hanhu chizzuk leakra dechuve hu daavidi. amar leh: veakra dechuve gufa tive mezuza, deha it ba dira leshomer bet haasurin, deha tanya: bet hakkeneset sheyyesh bo bet dira lechazzan hakkeneset chayyevet bimzuza!
Ella amar abbaye: mishshum sakkana. detanya: mezuzat yachid nivdeket paamayim bashshavua, veshel rabbim paamayim bayyovel.

Veamar rabbi yehuda: maase beartavin echad shehaya bodek mezuzot bashshuk haelyon shel tzippori, umetzao kasdor echad venatal mimmennu elef zuz. vehaamar rabbi elazar: sheluche mitzva en nizzokin? hecha dikvia hezzeka, shane. dichtiv: "vayyomer shemuel ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani vayyomer Adonai eglat bakar tikkach beyadecha veamarta lizboach laAdonai bati".

Tane rav kahana kammeh derav yehuda: bet hatteven uvet habbakar uvet haetzim uvet haotzarot peturim min hammezuza, mippene shehannashim neotot bahen. umay "neotot"? rochatzot. amar leh rav yehuda: tama derochatzot, ha setama — chayyayvin? vehatanya: refet bakar petura min hammezuza!

Ella: may "neotot" — mitkashshetot. vehachi katane: af al pi shehannashim mitkashshetot bahen, peturin. amar leh rav kahana: veshehannashim mitkashshetot bahen peturin, vehatanya: refet bakar petura min hammezuza, veshehannashim mitkashshetot bah chayyevet bimzuza!

Ella may it lach lememar, mitkashshetot tannae hi? ledidi name setama tannae hi. detanya: "betecha" — betcha hameyuchad lach, perat levet hatteven ulevet habbakar ulevet haetzim ulevet haotzarot, sheppeturin min hammezuza, veyesh mechayyeyvin.
Beemet amru, bet hakkisse uvet habbureski uvet hammerchatz uvet hattevila, veshehannashim neotot bahen peturim min hammezuza. rav kahana metaretz letameh verav yehuda metaretz letameh.

Rav kahana metaretz letameh: "betecha" — betcha hameyuchad lach, perat levet hatteven ulevet habbakar ulevet haetzim ulevet haotzarot, sheppeturim min hammezuza bistam. veyesh shemmechayyeyvim bistam. beemet amru: bet hakkisse uvet habbureski uvet hammerchatz uvet hattevila veshehannashim neotot bahen, umay "neotot" — rochatzot, peturin min hammezuza.

I hachi, hayeynu merchatz! ashmeinan merchatz derabbim veashmeinan merchatz deyachid. desalka datach amena: merchatz derabbim dinfish zuhameh, aval merchatz deyachid dela nefish zuhameh — ema lichayyayv bimzuza, ka mashma lan.

Verav yehuda metaretz letameh, hachi katane: "betecha" — betcha hameyuchad lach, perat levet hatteven uvet habbakar uvet haetzim uvet haotzarot sheppeturin min hammezuza, afillu mitkashshetot, veyesh mechayyeyvin bemitkashshetot, aval setam divre hakkol patur. beemet amru: bet hakkisse uvet habbureski uvet hammerchatz uvet hattevila, af al pi shehannashim mitkashshetot bahen peturin min hammezuza, mishshum dinfish zuhameh.

Ulerav yehuda setama divre hakkol patur, vehatanya: "bisharecha" — echad shaare vattim veechad shaare chatzerot veechad shaare medinot veechad shaare ayayrot, verefet velulin umatben veotzrot yayin veotzrot shemen chayyayvin bimzuza. yachol sheani merabbe af
b: Bet shaar, achsadra umirpeset — talmud lomar: "bayit", ma bayit meyuchad ledira, yatzu ellu sheen meyuchadin ledira.
Yachol sheani merabbe af bet hakkisse uvet habbureski uvet hammerchatz uvet hattevila — talmud lomar: "bayit", ma bayit heasuy lechavod — af kol heasuy lechavod, yatzu ellu sheen asuyin lechavod.
Yachol sheani merabbe af har habbayit vehalleshachot vehaazarot — talmud lomar: "bayit", ma bayit shehu chol — af kol shehu chol, yatzu ellu shehen kodesh. teyuveta.

Tane rav shemuel bar yehuda kammeh derava: shishsha shearim peturin min hammezuza: bet hatteven, uvet habbakar, uvet haetzim, uvet haotzarot, veshaar hammadi, veshaar sheeno mekore, veshaar sheeno gavoah asara. amar leh: patchat beshishsha, vesalkat beshiva!

Amar leh: shaar hammadi tannae hi. detanya: kippa, rabbi meir mechayyev bimzuza, vachachamim potrim. veshavin sheim yesh beraglah asara, shechayyevet bimzuza. amar abbaye: dechulle alma, gevoha asara veen beraglah shelosha — velav kelum hi. i name, yesh beraglah shelosha veenah gevoha asara — velav kelum hi.
Lo nechleku ella bigvoha asara veyesh beraglah shelosha veen berochbah arbaa, veyesh bah lachok lehashelimah learbaa. rabbi meir savar: chokkin lehashelim. verabbanan savri: en chokkin lehashelim.
Tanu rabbanan: bet hakkeneset uvet haishsha uvet hashshuttafin chayyevet bimzuza. peshita? mahu detema: "betecha" — velo betah, "betecha" — velo battehem, kamashma lan.
Veema hachi name? amar kera: "lemaan yirbu yemechem vime venechem", hane bau chayye vehane la bau chayye?!
Ella, "betecha" lema li? kidrava, deamar rava: derech biatcha, vechi akar inish — kareh deyammina akar beresha.
Tanya iddach: bet hakkeneset uvet hashshuttafin uvet haishsha mittammein bingaim. peshita? mahu detema: "uva asher lo habbayit", "lo" — velo lah, "lo" — velo lahen, ka mashma lan.

Veema hachi name! amar kera: "bevet eretz achuzzatchem". ella "lo" lema li? mi shemmeyayched beto lo, sheeno rotze lehasheil kelav veomer sheen lo, hakkadosh baruch hu mefarsemo keshemmefanne et beto. perat lemashil kelav laacherim.

Uvet hakkeneset mi mittamme bingaim? vehatanya: yachol yihyu batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot mittammein bingaim, talmud lomar: "uva asher lo habbayit" — mi shemyuchad lo, yatzu ellu sheen meyuchadin lo!
La kashya: ha — rabbi meir, ha — rabbanan. detanya: bet hakkeneset sheyyesh bah bet dira lechazzan hakkeneset — chayyayv bimzuza, vesheen bah bet dira — rabbi meir mechayyev, vachachamim potrin.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha rabbanan, vela kashya: ha — deit ba bet dira, ha — delet ba bet dira.
Vei baet ema: ha veha delet bah bet dira,

a: Veha — dichrakkim, veha — dichfarim.

Vedichrakkim en mittamme bingaim? vehatanya: "achuzzatchem", achuzzatchem mittammea bingaim, veen yerushalayim mittammea bingaim. amar rabbi yehuda: ani lo shamati ella mekom mikdash bilvad. ha batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot mittammein bingaim, veaf al gav dichrachim ninhu! ema: amar rabbi yehuda: ani lo shamati ella mekom mekuddash bilvad.
Bemay ka mippalgi? tanna kamma savar yerushalayim lo nitchalleka lishvatim, verabbi yehuda savar yerushalayim nitchalleka lishvatim.

Uviflugeta dehane tannae. detanya: me haya bechelko shel yehuda — har habbayit, halleshachot vehaazarot. ume haya bechelko shel binyamin — ulam vehechol uvet kodshe hakkodashim, uretzua hayta yotza mechelko shel yehuda venichneset lechelko shel binyamin, uvah haya mizbeach banuy, uvinyamin hatztzaddik haya mitztaer aleha levolah bechol yom,
Shenneemar: "chofef alav kol hayyom". lefichach zacha binyamin hatztzaddik venaasa ushepizchan ligvura, shenneemar: "uven ketefav shachen".

Vehay tanna savar yerushalayim lo nitchalleka lishvatim, detanya: en maskirin battim birushalayim lefi sheenah shellahen. rabbi elazar bar (tzadok) omer: af lo mittot. lefichach, orot kadashim — baale ushepizchanin notlin otan bizroa. amar abbaye: shema minna, orach ara lemishbak inish gulepa umashka leushepizeh.

Vedichfarim mi mittamme bingaim? vehatanya: "laachuzza", ad sheyyichbeshu otah. kavshu otah velo chillekuha lishvatim, chilleku lishvatim velo chilleku levet avot, chilleku levet avot veen kol echad makkir et shello, minnayin?
Talmud lomar: "uva asher lo habbayit", mi shemyuchad lo, yatza ellu sheen meyuchadin lo. ella mechavvavrta kidshannin meikkara.
Umatkinin lo kohen acher. peshita era bo pesul kodem tamid shel shachar — mechannechin oto betamid shel shachar. ella era bo pesul achar tamid shel shachar, bamme mechannechin oto?

Amar rav adda bar ahava: beavnet. hanicha leman deamar avneto shel kohen gadol, ze hu avneto shel kohen hedyot. ella leman deamar avneto shel kohen gadol lo zehu avneto shel kohen hedyot, may ikka lememar?
Amar abbaye: lovesh shemona, umehappech betzinnora, vechidrav huna. deamar rav huna: zar shehippech betzinnora — chayyayv mita. verav pappa amar:
b: Avodato mechannachto. mi la tanya kol hakkelim sheasa moshe — meshichatan mekaddashtan, mikkan veelach — avodatan mechannachtan. hacha name — avodato mechannachto.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar: avneto shel kohen hedyot, rabbi verabbi elazar berabbi shimon, chad amar: shel kilayim, vechad amar: shel butz.

Tistayyem derabbi hu deamar shel kilayim. detanya: en ben kohen gadol lechohen hedyot ella avnet, divre rabbi. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: af lo avnet. emat? i nema bishar yemot hashshana — tuva ikka: kohen gadol meshammesh bishmona vehedyot bearbaa!
Ella lav, beyom hakkippurim.
Amri: la, leolam bishar yemot hashshana, uvehanach deshavin.

Ki ata ravin, amar: avneto shel kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim — divre hakkol shel butz. bishar yemot hashshana — divre hakkol shel kilayim. lo nechleku ella beavneto shel kohen hedyot ben bishar yemot hashshana, ben beyom hakkippurim. sherabbi omer: shel kilayim, verabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: shel butz.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: af anan name tenena: "al besaro", ma talmud lomar "yilbash"? lehavi mitznefet veavnet laharamat haddeshen, divre rabbi yehuda.

Rabbi dosa omer: lehavi bigde kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim, shehen kesherin lechohen hedyot. rabbi omer: shete teshuvot baddavar. chada: deavneto shel kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim lo ze hu avneto shel kohen hedyot.
Veod: begadim shennishtammashta bahen kedushsha chamura, teshammesh bahen kedushsha kalla? ella ma talmud lomar "yilbash"? lerabbot et hashshechakin.
Veazda rabbi dosa letameh, detanya: "vehinnicham sham", melammed shetteunin geniza. rabbi dosa omer: shello yishtammesh bahen yom hakkippurim acher.
Tanu rabbanan: era bo pesul uminnu acher tachtav, rishon — chozer laavodato, sheni — kol mitzvot kehunna gedola alav, divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi yose omer: rishon — chozer laavodato, sheni — eno rauy lo lechohen gadol, velo lechohen hedyot,

Amar rabbi yose: maase beyosef ben illem betzippori sheera bo pesul bechohen gadol uminnuhu tachtav, veamru chachamim: rishon — chozer laavodato, sheni — eno rauy lo lechohen gadol, velo lechohen hedyot. kohen gadol — mishshum eva. kohen hedyot, mishshum maalin bakkodesh velo moridin.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan:

a: Halacha kerabbi yose, umode rabbi yose sheim avar veavad — avodato keshera. amar rav yehuda amar rav: halacha kerabbi yose, umode rabbi yose sheim met rishon, shechozer laavodato.
Peshita! mahu detema, havya leh tzara mechayyim. ka mashma lan.
Rabbi yehuda omer: af ishsha acheret matkinin lo. verabbanan name, ha chayyshi leshemma? amri lach rabbanan: tumea shechicha, mita la shechicha.

Amru lo: im ken, en laddavar sof. shappir ka amri leh lerabbi yehuda! verabbi yehuda — amar lach: lemita dachada — chayyshinan. lemita detarte — la chayyshinan. verabbanan? i ikka lemechash — afillu lemita ditren chayyshinan.
Verabbanan, nemru inhu lenafshayyhu! amri lach rabbanan: kohen gadol zariz hu. i zariz hu, lamma matkinin kohen acher? kevan deavdinan leh tzara, kol shekken demizdaraz tefe.

Umi saggi leh betakkanta? "beto" amar rachamana, vehach lav beto hi! dimkaddesh la. veha kamma dela kanes la — lav beto hi! dechanes lah. im ken, have leh shene vattim, verachamana amar: "vechipper baado uvead beto", velo bead shene vattim!
Dahadar megaresh la. i megaresh la, hadra kusheyayn leducheta! la tzericha, dimgaresh la al tenay. deamar la: hare ze gittech al menat [shettamuti. vedilma la mayyta, vehave leh shene vattim!

Ella deamar la: hare ze gittech al menat] shello tamuti. i la mayta — miggarsha la. vei mayta ha — kayyma hach. vedilma hi la mayta, vehave leh gitta dehay gitta, umayyta chaverta, vekam leh belo bayit!
Ella, deamar la: al menat shettamut [achat mikkem]. mayta ha — kayyma hach, mayta hach — ha kayyma ha. vedilma la mayyta vela chada minnayyhu, vehave leh shene vattim?
Veod: ki hay gavvna mi have gitta? vehaamar rava: "hare ze gittech al menat shello tishti yayin kol yeme chayyay vechayyaychi" — en ze keritut.
Kol yeme chayyay peloni — hare ze keritut!
Ella, deamar la: hare ze gittech al menat shello tamut chavertich. i la mayta chaverta — miggarsha, vei mayta ha — ha kayyma ha. vedilma mayyta chaverta befalga daavoda, veiggallay milleta
b: Lemafrea degitta deha lav gitta hu, veaved leh avoda bishne vattim! ella, deamar la: hare ze gittech al menat shettamut chavertich. vedilma mayyta chaverta, vehave leh gitta deha gitta, vekam leh belo bayit!

Ella, dimgaresh lehu letarvayyhu. lachada amar la: hare ze gittech al menat shello tamut chavertich, velachada amar la: hare ze gittech al menat shello tikkansi levet hakkeneset. vedilma la mayyta chaverta, vela ayyla hi levet hakkeneset, vehave leh gitta detarvayyhu gitta, vekam leh belo bayit!

Ella, lachada amar la: hare ze gittech al menat shello tamut chavertich. velachada amar la: hare ze gittech al menat sheekkanes ani levet hakkeneset. dei mayyta ha — kayyma ha, vei mayyta ha — kayyma ha. may ikka lememar? dilma mayyta chaverta befalga daavoda, veaved leh avoda lemafrea bishne vattim? i chaze la deka baaya lememat — kadem ihu veayel levet hakkeneset, umeshavve legitta deha gitta lemafrea.
Matkef la rav assi, veittema rav avvira: ella meatta, shete yevamot habbaot mibbayit echad, lo yityaybmu! "yevimto" "yevimto" ribba.
Matkef la ravina, veittema rav sherevya: ella meatta arusa lo tityaybem? "hachutza", lerabbot et haarusa.
Tanu rabbanan: kohen gadol makriv onen, veeno ochel. rabbi yehuda omer: kol hayyom. may "kol hayyom"? amar rava: lo nitzrecha ella lahavio mittoch beto.

Amar leh abbaye: hasheta lerabbi yehuda appoke mappekinan leh, detanya: haya omed umakriv al gabbe hammizbeach veshama shemmet lo met, manniach avodato veyotze, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: yigmor. veat amrat mayytinan leh mittoch beto?
Ella amar rava: may "kol hayyom" —

a: Lomar sheeno oved kol hayyom, gezera shemma yochal. amar leh rav adda bar ahava lerava: umi gazar rabbi yehuda shemma yochal? vehatnan, rabbi yehuda omer: af ishsha acheret matkinin lo, shemma tamut ishto. vei mayyta ishto aved avoda, vela gazar rabbi yehuda shemma yochal! amar leh: hachi hasheta?! hatam, kevan deyom hakkippurim hu, dechulle alma la ka achli, hu name la ate lemechal, hacha, dechulle alma achli — hu name ate lemechal.
Vechi hay gavvna mi chayyla aleh aninut? veha miggarsha! nehi daaninut la chayyla aleh, itterode mi la mitterid?

Mishna kol shivat hayyamim hu zorek et haddam, umaktir et hakketoret, umetiv et hannerot, umakriv et harosh veet haregel. ushear kol hayyamim im ratza lehakeriv — makriv, shekkohen gadol makriv chelek barosh, venotel chelek barosh.
Gemara man tanna? amar rav chisda, dela kerabbi akiva. dei rabbi akiva, ha amar: tahor shennafla alav hazzaa timmeattu, hechi aved avoda!
Detanya: "vehizza hattahor al hattame". al hattame — tahor, veal hattahor — tame, divre rabbi akiva. vachachamim omrim: en haddevarim hallalu amurin ella bidvarim hamekabbelim tumea.
May hi — keditnan: nitkavvevn lehazzot al habbehema vehizza al haadam, im yesh baezov — yishne. nitkavvevn lehazzot al haadam vehizza al habbehema, im yesh baezov — lo yishne.

May tama derabbi akiva? nichtov rachamana: "vehizza hattahor alav", may "al hattame"? shema minna al hattame — tahor, veal hattahor — tame. verabbanan: hay lidvarim hammekabbelin tumea hu daata. aval hacha, kal vachomer hu: im al hattame — tahor, al hattahor — lo kol shekken!
Verabbi akiva? hayeynu dekaamar shelomo "amarti echkama vehi rechoka mimmenni". verabbanan? hahu lammazze velammazzin alav — tahor, venogea bahen — tame.
Umazze tahor? vehachtiv: "umazze me hannidda yechabbes begadav". may "mazze" — nogea. vehachtiv "mazze", veha ketiv "nogea"? veod: mazze bae kibbus begadim, nogea la bae kibbus begadim!
Ella: may "mazze" — nose. venichtov rachamana "nose", may tama ketiv "mazze"? ha ka mashma lan devaenan shiur hazzaa.

Hanicha leman deamar: hazzaa tzericha shiur. ella leman deamar: hazzaa en tzericha shiur, may ikka lememar! afillu leman deamar hazzaa en tzericha shiur, hane mille aggabba degavra, aval bemana — tzericha shiur. ditnan: kamma yehe bahen vihe kede hazzaa — kede sheyyitbol
b: Rashe givolin veyazze. abbaye amar: afillu tema rabbi akiva, deaved avoda kulleh yoma, ulefanya maddu aleh, vetavel veaved heerev hashshemesh.
Umaktir et hakketoret umetiv et hannerot. alma ketoret beresha vahadar nerot. ureminhu: mi shezzacha bedishshun mizbeach happenimi, umi shezzacha bammenora, umi shezzacha bakketoret!
Amar rav huna: man tana tamid, rabbi shimon ish hammitzpa hu. veha ippecha shaminan leh, ditnan: ba lo lekeren mizrachit tzefonit — noten mizracha tzafona, maaravit deromit — noten maarava daroma.
Vetane ala, rabbi shimon ish hammitzpa meshanne battamid: mizrachit tzefonit — noten mizracha tzafona. maaravit deromit — noten maarava, veachar kach noten daroma.
Ella amar rabbi yochanan: man tena seder yoma — rabbi shimon ish hammitzpa hu.

Uremi seder yoma asseder yoma, ditnan: payis hashsheni — mi shochet, mi zorek, mi medashshen mizbeach happenimi, umi medashshen et hamenora, umi maale evarim lakkevesh. payis hashshelishi — chadashim lakketoret bou vehafisu!
Amar abbaye, la kashya: kan bahatavat shete nerot, kan bahatavat chamesh nerot.

Lememra deviktoret mafsek lehu? veha abbaye mesadder maaracha mishshemeh digmara, bedam hattamid mafsek lehu! amri, la kashya: hahi leabba shaul, ha lerabbanan. detanya: lo yetiv et hannerot veachar kach yaktir, ella yaktir veachar kach yetiv. abba shaul omer: metiv, veachar kach maktir.
May tama deabba shaul? dichtiv: "babboker babboker behetivo et hannerot", vahadar "yaktirenna". verabbanan? may kaamar rachamana:

a: Beiddan hatava tehe mikketar ketoret. dei la tema hachi, ben haarbayim, dichtiv: "uvehaalot aharon et hannerot ben haarbayim yaktirenna", hachi name divresha madlik nerot vahadar maktir ketoret shel ben haarbayim?! vechi tema hachi name, vehatanya: "meerev ad boker",

Ten lah middatah, shettehe doleket veholechet kol hallayla meerev vead boker. davar acher: "meerev ad boker", en lecha avoda shekkeshera meerev ad boker ella zo bilvad. ella may kaamar rachamana — beiddan hadelaka tehe mikketar ketoret, hacha name: beiddan hatava tehe mikketar ketoret.
Veabba shaul amar lach: shane hatam dichtiv: "oto".
Rav pappa amar: la kashya, ha — rabbanan, ha — abba shaul. bemay okemta lematnitin dehacha — kerabbanan, payis — keabba shaul,

Ema sefa: heviu lo et hattamid, keratzo umerak acher shechita al yado, nichnas lehaketir et hakketoret ulehetiv et hannerot — atan lerabbanan. resha vesefa rabbanan, umetziata abba shaul! amar lecha rav pappa: in, resha vesefa rabbanan, umetziata abba shaul.

Bishlama abbaye la amar kerav pappa, resha vesefa rabbanan umetziata abba shaul la mokem la. ella rav pappa, may tama la amar keabbayye? amar lach: tena beresha hatavat shete nerot, vahadar hatavat chamesh nerot?
Veabbaye amar lach: oroye bealma hu deka more, vesidra ha hadar tane leh.

Gufa: ba lo lekeren mizrachit tzefonit — noten mizrachit tzefonit, maaravit deromit — noten maaravit deromit. vetane ala: rabbi shimon ish hammitzpa meshanne battamid, ba lo lekeren mizrachit tzefonit — noten mizrachit tzefonit, maaravit deromit — noten maarava veachar kach noten daroma. may tama derabbi shimon ish hammitzpa?
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum chad deve rabbi yannay, amar kera: "useir izzim echad lechattat laAdonai al olat hattamid yease venisko", ola hi, veamar rachamana: aved ba maase chattat.
Ha ketzad? noten achat shehi shetayim kemaase ola, shetayim shehen shetayim kemaase chattat. velitten shetayim shehen arba kemaase ola, vearba shehen arba kemaase chattat!
Lo matzinu damim shemmechapperin vechozrin umechapperin. vechi matzinu damim shechetzyayn chattat vechetzyayn ola? ella al korchan hakkishan hakkatuv. hacha name: beal korchan hakkishan hakkatuv.
Hatam pissuk mattanot bealma hi. venittev achat shehi shetayim lematta, kemaase ola, shetayim shehen shetayim lemala, kemaase chattat!
Lo matzinu damim shechetzyayn lemala vechetzyayn lematta. vela? vehatnan: hizza mimmennu achat lemala vesheva lematta.
Kematzlif. may "kematzlif" — machve rav yehuda, kimnaggedana.
Vela? vehatnan: hizza mimmennu al tohoro shel mizbeach sheva peamim. may lav, appalgeh demizbeach, kidamri inashe: tehar tihara hu palga deyoma!
Amar rabba bar shela: la,
b: Aggufeh demizbeach, dichtiv: "ucheetzem hashshamayim latohar".
May shena deyahev ola beresha vahadar yahev dechattat? nittev beresha dechattat, vahadar nittev deola! kevan deola hi, hi kadma beresha.
Umay shena deyahev mizrachit tzefonit, umaaravit deromit, nittev deromit mizrachit, vahadar tzefonit maaravit! amri: ola teuna yesod, vekeren deromit mizrachit la hava leh yesod.

May shena deyahev beresha mizrachit tzefonit vahadar maaravit deromit? nittev beresha maaravit deromit vahadar mizrachit tzefonit! kevan deamar mar kol pinnot sheatta pone — lo yehu ella derech yamin lammizrach, beresha behahu paga.

Umimmay divola hu dekaamar rachamana aved ba maase chattat, vedilma: bechattat hu dekaamar rachamana aved ba maase ola! la salka datach, dichtiv: "al olat hattamid yease venisko", may kaamar rachamana: midde dechattat shedi aola.

Tenan hatam: amar lahem hamemunne tzeu vehaviu tale millishkat bet hattelaim. vahalo, lishkat hattelaim hayta bemiktzoa tzefonit maaravit. vearba leshachot hayu sham, achat lishkat hattelaim, veachat lishkat hachotamot, veachat lishkat bet hammoked, veachat lishka sheosin bah lechem happanim.
