Ureminhu: arba leshachot hayu levet hammoked, kekittoniyyot happetuchot latteraklin, shetayim bakkodesh, ushetayim bachol, verashe pesefasin mavdilin ben kodesh lachol. uma hayu meshammeshot? maaravit deromit — hi hayta lishkat tele korban.

a: Deromit mizrachit hi lishka shehayu osin bah lechem happanim. mizrachit tzefonit — bah ganzu bet chashmonay avne mizbeach sheshshikketzum malche goyim. tzefonit maaravit — bah yordin levet hattevila. amar rav huna: man tana middot — rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi.

Ditnan: ezrat nashim hayta orech mea usheloshim vechamesh al rochav mea usheloshim vechamesh, vearba leshachot hayu bearba miktzooteha, ume hayu meshammeshot? deromit mizrachit — hi hayta lishkat hannezirim, sheshsham nezirim mevashshelim et shalmehen umegallechin searan umeshallechin tachat haddud. mizrachit tzefonit — hi hayta lishkat dir haetzim, sheshsham kohanim baale mumin omdin umatliin beetzim, shekkol etz sheyyesh bo tolaat pasul legabbe mizbeach.

Tzefonit maaravit — hi hayta lishkat hametzorain. maaravit deromit, amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: shachachti me hayta meshammeshet. abba shaul omer: bah hayu notnin yayin vashemen, vehi hayta nikret "lishkat bet shemanayya".

Hachi name mistabbera derabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi, ditnan: kol hakketalim shehayu sham hayu gevohin, chutz mikkotel mizrachi, shehakkohen hassoref et happara omed behar hammishcha umechavvevn veroe keneged pitcho shel hechol bishat hazzaat haddam.

Utenan: kol happetachim shehayu sham govhan esrim amma verochban eser ammot. utenan: lifnim mimmennu soreg. utenan: lifnim mimmennu hachel eser ammot, ushetem esre maalot hayu sham, rum maala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma.

Chamesh esre maalot olot mittochah, hayyordot meezrat yisrael leezrat nashim, rum maala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma. utenan: ben haulam velammizbeach esrim ushetayim amma, ushetem esre maalot hayu sham, rum maala chatzi amma veshilchah chatzi amma.
Utenan, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: maala hayta sham ugevoha amma, veduchan natun aleha, uvo shalosh maalot shel chatzi chatzi amma.
I amrat bishlama rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi — hayeynu deikkassi leh pitcha.
Ella i amrat rabbanan, ha ikka palga deammeta demitchaze leh pitcha begavvevy!

Ella lav shema minna rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi. rav adda bar ahava amar: ha manni — rabbi yehuda hi. detanya: rabbi yehuda omer: hammizbeach memutztza veomed beemtza azara, usheloshim ushetayim ammot hayu lo,
b: Eser ammot keneged pitcho shel hechol, achat esre amma latztzafon, veachat esre amma laddarom, nimtza mizbeach mechuuon keneged hechol uchetalav.

Vei salka datach middot rabbi yehuda hi, mizbeach beemtza azara mi mashkachat leh? vehatnan: kol haazara hayta orech mea ushemonim vasheva al rochav mea usheloshim vechamesh. min hammizrach lammaarav — mea ushemonim vasheva; mekom derisat ragle yisrael — achat esre amma; mekom derisat ragle hakkohanim achat esre amma; mizbeach — sheloshim ushetayim; ben haulam velammizbeach — esrim ushetayim; vehahechol — mea amma; veachat esre amma achore bet hakkapporet.

Min haddarom latztzafon — mea usheloshim vechamesh; hakkevesh vehammizbeach — shishshim ushetayim; min hammizbeach velattabbaot — shemone ammot; mekom hattabbaot — esrim vearba; min hattabbaot lashshulchanot — arba; min hashshulchanot lannannasin — arba; min hannannasin lechotel azara — shemone ammot; vehammotar, ben hakkevesh velakkotel, umekom hannannasin.
Vei salka dataych middot rabbi yehuda hi — mizbeach beemtza azara mi mashkachat leh? ha rubba demizbeach bedarom kae!

a: Ella lav shema minna, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi. shema minna.
Rav adda bereh derav yitzchak amar: hay lishka aktzoye maktzeya, udeate mitztzafon mitchazya leh bedarom, udeate middarom mitchazya leh betzafon.
Umistabbera divmaaravit deromit havay. mimmay — midderamenan lechem happanim allechem happanim,
Umeshannenan, amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: mar ka chashev derech yamin, umar ka chashev derech semol.
b: I amrat bishlama bemaaravit deromit havay, hayeynu dimtaretz lechem happanim allechem happanim. ella i amrat tzefonit maaravit havay, sof sof may terutza delechem happanim! ella lav shema minna, bemaaravit deromit havay. shema minna.
Vehaamar mar: kol pinnot sheatta pone lo yihyu ella derech yamin lammizrach? hane mille baavoda. aval hacha — chushebana bealma hu.
Shekkohen gadol makriv chelek barosh venotel chelek barosh. tanu rabbanan: ketzad makriv chelek barosh? omer: ola zo ani makriv, mincha zo ani makriv.

Ketzad notel chelek barosh? omer: chattat zo ani ochel, asham ze ani ochel. venotel challa mishte challot, arba o chamesh mimmaase lechem happanim. rabbi omer: leolam chamesh, shenneemar: "vehayta leaharon ulevanav" — mechetza leaharon umechetza levanav.

Ha gufa kashya: amrat notel challa achat mishte challot, manni — rabbi hi, deamar palga shakel. ema metziata: arba o chamesh mimmaase lechem happanim, atan lerabbanan, deamri: la shakel palga. ema sefa, rabbi omer: leolam chamesh. resha vesefa rabbi, umetziata rabbanan?
Amar abbaye: resha umetziata rabbanan — umodu rabbanan bifrusa, delav orach ara lemitteva lechohen gadol.
